units.en: Therefore the upright man hates it so, tears his robe to bind his feet, and casts it off on the long road,
units.literal: Therefore the upright man hates it so, tears his robe to bind his feet, and casts it off on the long road,

units.zh: 獨立高山之頂，歡與麋鹿同羣，皦皦然絕其雰濁，誠恥之也，誠畏之也。」
units.en: stands alone on the high mountain's crown, takes joy in sharing a flock with deer, and in brightness severs the murky haze—he is ashamed of it; he is afraid of it."
units.literal: stands alone on the high mountain's crown, takes joy in sharing a flock with deer, and in brightness severs the murky haze—he is ashamed of it; he is afraid of it."

units.zh: 昉撰《雜傳》二百四十七卷，《地記》二百五十二卷，文章三十三卷。
units.en: Fang compiled Miscellaneous Biographies in 247 scrolls, Gazetteer of Lands in 252 scrolls, and literary works in 33 scrolls.
units.literal: Fang compiled Miscellaneous Biographies in two hundred forty-seven scrolls, Gazetteer of Lands in two hundred fifty-two scrolls, and literary works in thirty-three scrolls.

units.zh: 昉第四子東里，頗有父風，官至尚書外兵郎。
units.en: Fang's fourth son Dongli had much of his father's manner and reached office as Secretariat Master of External Troops.
units.literal: Fang's fourth son Dongli had much of his father's manner and reached office as Secretariat Master of External Troops.

units.zh: 陳吏部尚書姚察曰：觀夫二漢求賢，率先經術；
units.en: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: In the two Han they sought the worthy and put classical learning first;
units.literal: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: Considering how the two Han sought the worthy, they put classical learning first;

units.zh: 近世取人，多由文史。
units.en: in recent times men were taken mostly through letters and histories.
units.literal: in recent times men were taken mostly through letters and histories.

units.zh: 二子之作，辭藻壯麗，允值其時。
units.en: The two men's works are gorgeously ornate—truly they matched their time.
units.literal: The two men's works are gorgeously ornate—truly they matched their time.

units.zh: 淹能沉靜，昉持內行，並以名位終始，宜哉。
units.en: Yan could hold stillness within; Fang kept inner conduct—both ended in name and rank from start to finish, as they should.
units.literal: Yan could hold stillness within; Fang kept inner conduct—they both ended in name and rank from start to finish, as they should.

units.zh: 江非先覺，任無舊恩，則上秩顯贈，亦末由也已。
units.en: Had Jiang not been foreknowing and Ren not held old favor, high rank and splendid gifts at the end would not have come about.
units.literal: Had Jiang not been foreknowing and Ren not held old favor, then high rank and splendid gifts at the end would not have come about.

units.zh: 戊戌，以荊州刺史嶷爲尚書令、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、揚州刺史，冠軍將軍映爲荊州刺史，西中郎將晃爲南徐州刺史，冠軍將軍垣崇祖爲豫州刺史，驃騎司馬崔文仲爲徐州刺史。
units.en: Day wuxu: Yi, inspector of Jing, became director of the master of writing, general-in-chief who spreads might, with secretariat equal to the three excellencies, and inspector of Yang; Ying, champion general, inspector of Jing; Huang, west general of the gentlemen, inspector of South Xuzhou; Yuan Chongzu, champion general, inspector of Yu; Cui Wenzong, chief commandant under the general who spreads might, inspector of Xu.
units.literal: On day wuxu, Inspector of Jing Province Luan was made Director of the Master of Writing, General-in-Chief Who Spreads Might, with Grand Secretariat and staff equal to the Three Excellencies, and Inspector of Yang Province; General Who Vanquishes the Foe Ying was made Inspector of Jing Province; West General of the Gentlemen Huang was made Inspector of South Xuzhou; General Who Vanquishes the Foe Yuan Chongzu was made Inspector of Yu Province; Chief Commandant of the General Who Spreads Might Cui Wenzong was made Inspector of Xu Province.

units.zh: 立皇子嶷爲豫章王，映爲臨川王，晃爲長沙王，曅爲武陵王，暠爲安成王，鏘爲鄱陽王，鑠爲桂陽王，鑒爲廣陵王，皇孫長懋爲南郡王。
units.en: Princes were named: Yi of Yuzhang, Ying of Linchuan, Huang of Changsha, Ye of Wuling, Gao of Ancheng, Qiang of Poyang, Shuo of Guiyang, Jian of Guangling; the imperial grandson Zhangmao became prince of Nan commandery.
units.literal: The princes Luan was made Prince of Yuzhang; Ying Prince of Linchuan; Huang Prince of Changsha; Ye Prince of Wuling; Gao Prince of Ancheng; Qiang Prince of Poyang; Shuo Prince of Guiyang; Jian Prince of Guangling; the imperial grandson Zhangmao Prince of Nan.

units.zh: 乙巳，以新除尚書令、驃騎將軍豫章王嶷爲荊、湘二州刺史，平西將軍臨川王映爲揚州刺史。
units.en: Day yisi: Yi, new director of the master of writing and general who spreads might, prince of Yuzhang, took Jing and Xiang; Ying, prince of Linchuan and general who pacifies the west, took Yang.
units.literal: On day yisi the newly appointed Director of the Master of Writing, General-in-Chief Who Spreads Might, Prince of Yuzhang Luan was made Inspector of Jing and Xiang; General Who Pacifies the West, Prince of Linchuan Ying was made Inspector of Yang.

units.zh: 壬子，以驃騎大將軍豫章王嶷爲司空，揚州刺史、前將軍臨川王映爲荊州刺史。
units.en: On day renzi, Prince of Yuzhang Xiao Yi, general of agile cavalry, became minister of works; Prince of Linchuan Xiao Ying, forward general and inspector of Yangzhou, took Jing.
units.literal: On day renzi, General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Yuzhang Xiao Luan was made Minister of Works; Inspector of Yangzhou, Forward General, Prince of Linchuan Xiao Ying was made Inspector of Jing.

units.zh: 丙子，以平北將軍陳顯達爲益州刺史，貞陽公柳世隆爲南兖州刺史，皇子鋒爲江夏王。
units.en: On day bingzi, Chen Xianda, pacifying north, took Yi; Liu Shilong, duke of Zhenyang, took South Yanzhou; the prince Feng was enfeoffed as prince of Jiangxia.
units.literal: On day bingzi, Pacifying North General Chen Xianda was made Inspector of Yi; Duke of Zhenyang Liu Shilong was made Inspector of South Yanzhou; the imperial son Feng was made Prince of Jiangxia.

units.zh: 時，大將軍袁紹總兵冀州，遣使要玄，大會賓客，玄最後至，乃延升上坐。
units.en: Yuan Shao of Ji invited him to a great banquet; Zheng Xuan came last and was shown to the highest seat.
units.literal: At that time the general-in-chief Yuan Shao commanded troops in Ji province, sent an envoy to invite Xuan, and held a great assembly of guests; Xuan arrived last and was then led up to the seat of honor.

units.zh: 紹乃舉玄茂才，表為左中郎將，皆不就。
units.en: Yuan Shao then nominated him flourishing talent and recommended him as general of the household for the left; Zheng Xuan refused both.
units.literal: Shao thereupon recommended Xuan as flourishing talent and memorialized him as general of the household for the left, but in neither case did he accept.

units.zh: 時袁紹與曹操相拒於官度，令其子譚遣使逼玄隨軍，不得已，載病到元城縣，疾篤不進，其年六月卒，年七十四。
units.en: While Yuan Shao and Cao Cao faced off at Guandu, Yuan Tan sent men to drag him to camp; he yielded, rode sick to Yuancheng, could go no farther, and died there that sixth month at seventy-four.
units.literal: At that time Yuan Shao and Cao Cao faced each other at Guandu; he ordered his son Tan to send an envoy to force Xuan to accompany the army; unable to avoid it, he carried his illness to Yuancheng county, grew too gravely ill to advance, and in the sixth month of that year died at age seventy-four.

units.zh: 紹客多豪俊，並有才說，見玄儒者，未以通人許之，競設異端，百家互起。
units.en: Yuan's guests were swaggering debaters who, seeing a mere Ru, denied him mastery and tried every paradox from every school.
units.literal: Shao's guests were mostly bold and outstanding, all possessed of talent and argument; seeing Xuan as a mere scholar, they did not grant him the status of a thorough man of the world, vied to pose strange positions, and the hundred schools rose against one another.

units.zh: 時汝南應劭亦歸於紹，因自贊曰：『故太山太守應中遠，北面稱弟子何如？』
units.en: Ying Shao of Runan, also Yuan's client, boasted: "I am Ying Zhongyuan, late prefect of Taishan—may I face north as your disciple?"
units.literal: At that time Ying Shao of Runan also had attached himself to Shao and therefore praised himself, saying: 'The former grand administrator of Taishan Ying Zhongyuan—how would it be to face north and call myself disciple?'

units.zh: 靈帝末，黨禁解，大將軍何進聞而辟之。
units.en: Near the end of Lingdi's reign the ban ended; He Jin the general-in-chief heard of him and called him in.
units.literal: At the end of the Ling Emperor's reign the partisan prohibition was lifted; the general-in-chief He Jin heard of him and summoned him.

units.zh: 「今世之處士，魁然無徒，廓然獨居，上觀許由，下察接輿，計同范蠡，忠合子胥，天下和平，與義相扶，寡耦少徒，固其宜也，子何疑於我哉？
units.en: "Today's hermits stand aloof like giants without a retinue, scan the past for Xu You and Jie Yu, compare their schemes to Fan Li and their loyalty to Wu Zixu, yet live in a tranquil age where righteousness needs no loud champion. Of course they walk alone with few companions. Why should you find that strange in me?
units.literal: "Now the recluses of the age — towering, without followers; vastly alone in dwelling; above they gaze on Xu You, below they examine Jie Yu; in planning they match Fan Li, in loyalty they accord with Zixu; under Heaven is peace and harmony, they support one another with righteousness — few mates, few followers — solidly it is fitting; why do you, sir, doubt me?

units.zh: 先生曰：「接輿避世，箕子被髮陽狂，此二人者，皆避濁世以全其身者也。
units.en: The gentleman said: "Jieyu avoided the age; Jizi let his hair down and feigned madness—these two men both avoided a turbid age to preserve their persons.
units.literal: The gentleman said: Jieyu avoided the age; Jizi let his hair down and feigned madness—these two men both avoided a turbid age to preserve their persons.

units.zh: 雖伯牙操遞鍾，逢門子彎烏號，猶未足以喻其意也。
units.en: Not even Boya on the Di Zhong harp or Fengmenzi drawing the Wuhao bow could capture the harmony of that meeting.
units.literal: Even if Boya grasped the Di Zhong zither, Fengmenzi bent the Wuhao bow, still they would not be sufficient to analogize its meaning.

units.zh: 心膂之任可委劉悛、蕭惠休、崔惠景。」
units.en: Tasks of the heart and sinew may be entrusted to Liu Jun, Xiao Huixiu, and Cui Huijing."
units.literal: Tasks of the heart and sinew may be entrusted to Liu Jun, Xiao Huixiu, and Cui Huijing."

units.zh: 己酉，帝崩于正福殿，年四十七。
units.en: Day jiyou: the emperor died in the Hall of Correct Blessing, aged forty-seven.
units.literal: Day jiyou: the emperor died in the Hall of Correct Blessing, aged forty-seven.

units.zh: 然則荊軻之湛七族，要離之燒妻子，豈足道哉！
units.en: If so, then what Jing Ke suffered—the destruction of his seven kindred clans—or what Yao Li endured—the burning of his wife and children—would scarcely be worth mentioning!
units.literal: Then Jing Ke drowned seven clans, Yao Li burned wife children, how sufficient speak!

units.zh: 然支父有讓王之介，嚴子有傲帝之規，千載美談，所不廢也。
units.en: Yet Zhi Fu refused the throne, and Yan Zi defied his ruler—tales a thousand years old that are not forgotten.
units.literal: Yet Zhi Fu had the manner of yielding the kingship, and Yan Zi had the plan of defying the emperor—thousand-year fine tales that are not abandoned.

units.zh: 元康曰：「嘗讀《崔琰傳》，追恨魏武不弘。
units.en: Yuankang said, "I once read the biography of Cui Yan and regretted that Wei Wu was not magnanimous.
units.literal: Yuankang said: "I once read the biography of Cui Yan and regretted that Wei Wu was not magnanimous.

units.zh: 譬若以周、邵為丞相，孔丘為御史大夫，太公為將軍，畢公高拾遺於後，弁嚴子為衛尉，皋陶為大理，後稷為司農，伊尹為少府，子贛使外國，顏、閔為博士，子夏為太常，益為右扶風，季路為執金吾，契為鴻臚，龍逢為宗正，伯夷為京兆，管仲為馮翊，魯般為將作，仲山甫為光祿，申伯為太僕，延陵季子為水衡，百里奚為典屬國，柳下惠為大長秋，史魚為司直，蘧伯玉為太傅，孔父為詹事，孫叔敖為諸侯相，子產為郡守，王慶忌為期門，夏育為鼎官，羿為旄頭，宋萬為式道候。」
units.en: Imagine the Duke of Zhou and the Duke of Shao as your chancellors; Confucius as chief censor; the Grand Duke as commander; Duke Bi Gao as court remonstrant; Bian Zhuangzi as captain of the guard; Gao Yao as chief judge; Hou Ji as minister of agriculture; Yi Yin as palace treasurer; Zigong as foreign envoy; Yan Hui and Min Ziqian as court scholars; Zixia as master of rites; Yi as western capital intendant; Zilu as capital commandant; Xie as master of guest ceremonies; Guan Longpeng as keeper of the imperial genealogy; the minister Boyi as metropolitan governor; Guan Zhong as northern capital intendant; Lu Ban as chief engineer; Zhong Shanfu as palace chamberlain; the Earl of Shen as master of the horse; Prince Jizi of Yanling as keeper of parks and waters; Baili Xi as commissioner for dependent peoples; Liuxia Hui as chamberlain to the empress; Shi Yu as censor of conduct; Qu Boyu as grand tutor; Kong Fu as supervisor of the heir apparent's household; Sunshu Ao as chancellor to the feudal lords; Zichan as commandery governor; Prince Qingji as a palace gate guard; Xia Yu as cauldron officer; Yi the Archer as vanguard officer; and Song Wan as road-clearing scout."
units.literal: It is as if you had made the Duke of Zhou and the Duke of Shao your chancellors; Confucius your Censor-in-Chief; the Grand Duke your general; Duke Bi Gao your remonstrant at the rear; Bian Zhuangzi your Commandant of the Guards; Gao Yao your Chief Justice; Hou Ji your Minister of Agriculture; Yi Yin your Privy Treasurer; Zigong your envoy abroad; Yan Hui and Min Ziqian your Erudites; Zixia your Minister of Ceremonies; Yi your western capital intendant; Zilu your Capital Commandant; Xie your Grand Herald; Guan Longpeng your Director of the Imperial Clan; the minister Boyi your Metropolitan Governor; Guan Zhong your northern capital intendant; Lu Ban your Superintendent of Works; Zhong Shanfu your Chamberlain for Attendants; the Earl of Shen your Grand Coachman; Prince Jizi of Yanling your Superintendent of Waters and Parks; Baili Xi your Director of Dependent States; Liuxia Hui your Chamberlain for the Empress; Shi Yu your Rectifier; Qu Boyu your Grand Tutor; Kong Fu your supervisor of the heir apparent's household; Sunshu Ao your chancellor to the feudal lords; Zichan your commandery governor; Prince Qingji your Palace Gate Guard; Xia Yu your Cauldron Officer; Yi the Archer your Vanguard Officer; and Song Wan your road-clearing scout."

units.zh: 贍人之急，雖乏必先，使施如王丹，受如杜林，亦可與言交矣。
units.en: Relieve others' urgent need, though you yourself are poor—give as Wang Dan gave, receive as Du Lin received, and you may speak of true friendship.
units.literal: Relieving others' urgency, though oneself is lacking yet putting them first—if giving is like Wang Dan and receiving like Du Lin, one may also speak of friendship with them.

units.zh: 元嘉三年，羨之等誅，徵為中書侍郎，尋轉太子中庶子，頃之，領步兵校尉，賞遇甚厚。
units.en: In the third year of Yuanjia (426), after Xu Xianzhi and his faction were put to death, Yanzhi was recalled as Vice Director of the Secretariat, then made Vice Grandee of the Crown Prince's Household; soon he also served as Colonel of Footsoldiers and enjoyed lavish favor.
units.literal: In the third year of Yuanjia, Xu Xianzhi and others were executed; he was summoned as Vice Director of the Secretariat, soon transferred to Vice Grandee of the Crown Prince's Household, and shortly after concurrently Colonel of Footsoldiers, with very generous rewards and favor.

units.zh: 閑居無事，為庭誥之文。
units.en: In his leisure at home he wrote his Household Admonitions.
units.literal: Living in retirement without affairs, he composed a text of Household Admonitions.

units.zh: 曹植儻豫聞高論，則不殞令名；
units.en: If Cao Zhi by chance heard your lofty discourse, his fine name would not perish;
units.literal: If Cao Zhi by chance heard your lofty discourse, his fine name would not perish;

units.zh: 才謝天人，多慚子建。
units.en: in talent I fall short of heaven and man, and am much ashamed before Zijian.
units.literal: in talent I fall short of heaven and man, and am much ashamed before Zijian.

units.zh: 東魏主不堪憂辱，詠謝靈運詩曰：「韓亡子房奮，秦帝魯連恥。
units.en: Unable to bear the anguish and humiliation, the Eastern Wei emperor recited a poem of Xie Lingyun: "When Han perished Zhang Liang rose in zeal; before the Qin emperor Lu Zhong felt shame.
units.literal: Unable to bear the anguish and humiliation, the Eastern Wei emperor recited a poem of Xie Lingyun: "When Han perished Zhang Liang rose in zeal; before the Qin emperor Lu Zhong felt shame.

units.zh: 子野與沛國劉顯、南陽劉之遴、陳郡殷芸、陳留阮孝緒、吳郡顧協、京兆韋棱，皆博極羣書，深相賞好，顯尤推重之。
units.en: Ziye, together with Liu Xian of Peiguo, Liu Zhilin of Nanyang, Yin Yun of Chen commandery, Ruan Xiaoxu of Chenliu, Gu Xie of Wu commandery, and Wei Leng of Jingzhao, had all read exhaustively and were close friends; Xian especially esteemed him.
units.literal: Ziye, together with Liu Xian of Peiguo, Liu Zhilin of Nanyang, Yin Yun of Chen commandery, Ruan Xiaoxu of Chenliu, Gu Xie of Wu commandery, and Wei Leng of Jingzhao, all ranged to the utmost through the books and deeply admired and befriended one another; Xian especially valued him.

units.zh: 昔燕太子使荆轲劫始皇，变起两楹之间，其后谒者持匕首刺腋，高祖偃武行文，故易之以板。」
units.en: Formerly the crown prince of Yan sent Jing Ke to seize the First Emperor; the crisis arose between the two pillars, and afterward receptionists carried daggers at the armpit. Gaozu laid aside arms and promoted culture, and therefore replaced them with tablets."
units.literal: Formerly the crown prince of Yan sent Jing Ke to seize the First Emperor; the crisis arose between the two pillars, and afterward a receptionist stabbed him in the armpit with a dagger. Emperor Gaozu laid aside arms and promoted culture, and therefore replaced daggers with tablets."

units.zh: 夏，四月，甲午，立南郡王昭業為皇太孫，東宮文武悉改為太孫官屬，以太子妃琅邪王氏為皇太孫太妃，南郡王妃何氏為皇太孫妃。
units.en: In summer, the fourth month, on jiawu, Prince Zhaoye of Nan Commandery was named imperial grandson; Eastern Palace officials were retitled as imperial-grandson staff; the late crown prince's consort, Lady Wang of Langye, became grand consort to the imperial grandson; and Prince Zhaoye's consort, Lady He, became consort of the imperial grandson.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jiawu, Prince of Nanjun Zhaoye was established as imperial grandson; all Eastern Palace civil and military offices were changed to imperial-grandson staff; the crown prince's consort, Lady Wang of Langye, was made grand consort to the imperial grandson; the Prince of Nanjun's consort, Lady He, was made consort of the imperial grandson.

units.zh: 世祖武皇帝下永明十一年（癸酉，公元四九三年） 。
units.en: Yongming year 11 of Emperor Wu of Qi (Guiyou, 493 CE).
units.literal: Under the Shizu, Emperor Wu, Yongming year 11 (Guiyou, 493 CE).

units.zh: 沛郡桓譚為司空掾，典其議，為甄豐言：「凡此數者，必有一是。
units.en: Huan Tan of Pei, serving as a Works clerk, oversaw the debate and told Zhen Feng: "Among these proposals, at least one is correct.
units.literal: Huan Tan of Pei commandery, as clerk in Chief Works, handled these discussions and told Zhen Feng: "Among these several proposals, one must be right.

units.zh: 宜詳考驗，皆可豫見，計定然後舉事，費不過數億萬，亦可以事諸浮食無產業民。
units.en: They should be examined and tested rigorously, since outcomes can be predicted in advance. Decide the plan first, then act. Costs should stay within a few hundred million, while also employing idle, landless populations.
units.literal: They should be carefully tested in detail; all can be foreseen. Set calculations then act. The cost will not exceed several hundred million and can also employ those floating people without livelihoods.

units.zh: 空居與行役，同當衣食；
units.en: Whether idle or in labor service, people require food and clothing all the same.
units.literal: Being idle and serving labor are alike in needing clothing and food;

units.zh: 衣食縣官，而為之作，乃兩便，可以上繼禹功，下除民疾。」
units.en: If the state feeds and clothes them while employing them in works, both sides benefit - continuing Yu's legacy above and relieving popular hardship below."
units.literal: If state provides food and clothing and has them work, it is beneficial both ways: above continue Yu's achievement, below remove people's suffering."

units.zh: 憲時年十四，被召為國子正言生，謁祭酒到溉，溉目而送之，愛其神彩。
units.en: Xian was fourteen when he was made a Correct Sayings student at the National University. He visited libationer Dao Gai, who watched him leave and admired his bearing.
units.literal: Xian was then fourteen and was summoned as a Correct Sayings student of the National University; he called on the libationer Dao Gai, who watched him departing and admired his spirit and bearing.

units.zh: 大同八年，武帝撰孔子正言章句，詔下國學，宣制旨義。
units.en: In Datong year eight the emperor composed his commentary on the Correct Sayings of Confucius and ordered the National University to expound the imperial interpretation.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Datong the Emperor composed section-and-clause commentary on the Correct Sayings of Confucius and ordered it sent down to the National University to proclaim the imperial meaning.

units.zh: 唐虞之際，至治之極，猶流共工，放讙兜，竄三苗，殛鯀，然後天下服。
units.en: In the age of Yao and Shun, even at the height of good government, they still exiled Gonggong, banished Huandou, deported the Sanmiao, and executed Gun; only then did all under heaven submit.
units.literal: In the era of Yao and Shun, at the extreme of good governance, they still exiled Gonggong, banished Huandou, deported Sanmiao, executed Gun, and only then did the realm submit.

units.zh: 豫章王言之世祖，時吳郡太守王慈、太常張緒、尚書陸澄竝表論其事，世祖嘉其義，慮相復報，乃遣謙之隨曹虎西行。
units.en: The Prince of Yuzhang reported to Emperor Wu. Administrator Wang Ci, Zhang Xu of the Ministry of Rites, and Lu Cheng of the Ministry of the Interior all memorialized on the case. The emperor admired Qianzhi's conduct but feared further blood feuds, and sent him west with Cao Hu.
units.literal: The Prince of Yuzhang reported this to Emperor Wu; at the time the Administrator of Wu commandery Wang Ci, the Minister of Ceremonies Zhang Xu, and the Minister of the Interior Lu Cheng all memorialized on the matter. Emperor Wu admired his righteousness but feared mutual reprisals, and therefore sent Qianzhi west with Cao Hu.

units.zh: 世祖曰：「此皆是義事，不可問。」
units.en: Emperor Wu said: "These are all acts of righteousness and must not be prosecuted."
units.literal: Emperor Wu said: "These are all matters of righteousness and must not be prosecuted."

units.zh: 悉赦之。
units.en: He pardoned them all.
units.literal: He pardoned them all.

units.zh: 永明五年，世祖詔曰：「龍驤將軍、安西中兵參軍、松滋令蕭叡明，愛敬淳深，色養盡禮，喪過乎哀，遂致毀滅。
units.en: In the fifth year of Yongming Emperor Wu decreed: "Xiao Ruiming, Flying Dragon General, central army aide of the Anxi army, and magistrate of Songzi, loved his parents with pure devotion, served them with joyful ritual care, and mourned so deeply that he destroyed himself.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Yongming, Emperor Wu issued an edict: "The Flying Dragon General, Central Army Aide of the Anxi Army, and Magistrate of Songzi, Xiao Ruiming, loved and revered with pure depth, nourished his parents with cheerful countenance and full ritual, and in mourning exceeded proper grief until he destroyed himself.

units.zh: 雖未達聖教，而一至可愍。
units.en: Though he did not attain the sage's teaching, his utmost devotion is deeply moving.
units.literal: Though he did not attain the sage's teaching, his utmost sincerity is pitiable.

units.zh: 宜加榮命，以矜善人。
units.en: Let posthumous honors be granted to commend his goodness.
units.literal: He should be granted posthumous honor to commend a good man.

units.zh: 可贈中書郎。」
units.en: Let him be posthumously appointed Attendant of the Secretariat."
units.literal: Let him be posthumously appointed Attendant of the Secretariat."

units.zh: 世祖以為南康王子琳侍讀。
units.en: Emperor Wu appointed him reader to Prince Zilin of Nankang.
units.literal: Emperor Wu appointed him Reader to the Prince of Nankang, Zilin.

units.zh: 隆昌末，預謂丹陽尹徐孝嗣曰：「外傳藉藉，似有伊周之事，君蒙武帝殊常之恩，荷託付之重，恐不得同人此舉。
units.en: Late in Longchang Yu told Xu Xiaosi, governor of Danyang: "Rumors are rife, as though men plot like Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou. You received extraordinary favor from Emperor Wu and bear a heavy trust—I fear you cannot join them.
units.literal: At the end of Longchang, Yu said to Xu Xiaosi, Governor of Danyang: "Rumors are widespread, as though there were a matter like Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou; you have received Emperor Wu's extraordinary grace and bear the weight of his entrustment—I fear you cannot join in this undertaking.

units.zh: 論曰：吳起與田文論功，文不及者三，朱買臣難公孫弘十策，弘不得其一，終之田文相魏，公孫宰漢，誠知宰相自有體也。
units.en: The historian remarks: Wu Qi disputed merit with Tian Wen and surpassed him in three ways; Zhu Maichen posed ten challenges to Gongsun Hong that Hong could not meet—yet Tian Wen became chief minister of Wei and Gongsun governed Han. Chancellorship is a different art altogether.
units.literal: The appraisal says: Wu Qi debated merit with Tian Wen; Wen did not reach him in three respects; Zhu Maichen challenged Gongsun Hong with ten strategies; Hong did not obtain one of them—in the end Tian Wen ministered Wei, Gongsun ruled Han; truly they knew the prime minister has his own substance.

units.zh: 父智伯，與高祖鄰居，少相友善，嘗入高祖臥內，見有異光成五色，因握高祖手曰：「公後必大貴，非人臣也。
units.en: His father Zhibo lived next to Gaozu; they were friends from youth; once he entered Gaozu's bedchamber and saw a five-colored light; he took Gaozu's hand and said, "You are destined for greatness—not the fate of a subject.
units.literal: Father Zhibo was Gaozu's neighbor; from youth they were friendly; he once entered Gaozu's sleeping chamber and saw a strange light in five colors; he grasped Gaozu's hand and said: "Your Grace will surely rise to great nobility—not the lot of a subject.

units.zh: 及高祖踐阼，官至梁、秦二州刺史。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne he rose to inspector of Liang and Qin.
units.literal: When Gaozu ascended the throne he reached inspector of Liang and Qin.

units.zh: 對捍使者尚得死坐，況遊道吐不臣之言，犯慢上之罪，口稱夷、齊，心懷盜跖，欺公賣法，受納苞苴，產隨官厚，財與位積，雖贓汚未露，而姦詐如是。
units.en: Resisting an envoy earns death; how much more unministered words, slighting superiors, mouth naming Yi and Qi while heart harbors robbers, deceiving the public, taking bribes—wealth piled with rank though bribery was not yet exposed.
units.literal: Resisting an envoy still earns death; how much more Youdao's unministered words, the crime of slighting superiors, mouth naming Yi and Qi while heart harboring robbers, deceiving the public and selling the law, receiving wrapped bribes—property following office thick, wealth with rank piled; though bribery was not yet exposed, treachery was such.
